title: Reuse WST Elements on the Web
description: Windows State Triggers is an open source library of reusable Visual State Triggers for Windows 10 apps developed by Morten Nielsen. With WebAssembly and Uno Platform, just for the fun of it, we put it on the Web.

title: Uno Platform "Uno To Do" reference app
description: Fly your Launchpad to the moon. ☆.。.:*・°☆

title: Manipulate an In-Browser Database
description: This is a demo of the combination of Roslyn, Entity Framework Core, SQLite and the Uno Platform all working together to manipulate an in-browser database.

title: Uno Playground
description: This is the code for published apps on stores (Uno Gallery) - Windows, Android & iOS and for the Uno Playground http://playground.platform.uno.

title: Uno Calculator
description: We ported the open source Windows Calculator to Android, iOS , macOS, Web and even Linux! This is a great proof of concept for the level of code reusability you can achieve with Uno Platform across Web, Desktop and Mobile.

title: XAML Controls Gallery & Uno Platform
description: Uno Platform on WebAssembly targeting iOS, Android and Windows/macOS/Linux (using Chrome). This is Microsoft’s XAML Controls Gallery running on the Web, courtesy of WebAssembly and Uno Platform.

title: Multiplatform Messages Sample in Uno Platform
description: I created this sample inspired by this tweet by Jordan Singer. It shows a concept of a Messages app running on Windows 10, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Android & WebAssembly using Uno Platform (see also on GitHub).

title: High-Quality Animation to any Native App
description: Lottie is a library designed by Airbnb that lets you easily add high-quality animation to any native app.

title: Uno Platform port of Windows Community Toolkit
description: This port allows for Uno Platform based apps to use Windows Community Toolkit for WinUI 3 on Windows, iOS, macOS, Android, WebAssembly and Linux.

title: SkiaSharp.Extended for WebAssembly
description: This repository is the home for the port of SkiaSharp.Extended packages for WebAssembly with the Uno Platform. This package uses the Uno.SkiaSharp.Wasm package for WebAssembly.

title: UADO
description: We've built UADO to show you what's possible with the Uno Platform – a single codebase, native mobile and WebAssembly app, using only C# and XAML – currently the only platform to do so.

title: Multiplatform Health
description: This sample shows a concept of a Health app running on Windows 10, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Android & WebAssembly using Uno Platform (see also on GitHub). Inspired by Jordan Singer.
